title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: Curing the Maturity Condition
content:
**Which plans can be cured.** Only Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases plans whose cure setting is permitted can be cured. A death or sale case is never cured and ends only by resolution.

**Cure record.** A case is cured only on a cure-evidence request on file for the case whose request status is received and whose evidence type matches the plan's cure evidence:

| Plan family | Cure evidence |
|---|---|
| the occupancy plans | a reoccupancy certification recorded on the residency profile |
| property charge default | a repayment receipt showing every unrepaid property-charge advance repaid, or a signed repayment plan |
| property condition default | a passing repair inspection |

The borrower's oral statement is never enough, following the plan's setting on oral statements. The authority is the request as Cedarline records it, matched by its own reference.

**Deadline.** The cure must arrive by the plan's cure deadline basis:

- the occupancy plans: only before the loan is called due;
- the default plans: only before the case is referred to foreclosure.

A later request is declined as cure not permitted.

**Effect.**

- A cured case closes with resolution type cured on the cure date.
- A cure confirmation notice is sent.
- A loan that had been called due is reinstated.

**Condition repairs.** When a borrower reports property condition repairs complete, a reinspection is ordered within the plan's condition repair inspection days, counted in calendar days. Its passing report is the cure evidence.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Plan | Situation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Principal Residence Change | reoccupancy certification received while the loan is not yet called due | cured |
| Principal Residence Change | reoccupancy certification received after the loan is called due | declined, cure not permitted |
| Property Charge Default | repayment receipt for every unrepaid advance, case not yet referred | cured; a loan already called due is reinstated |
| Property Condition Default | borrower says by telephone that repairs are done | not a cure; a reinspection is ordered |
| Sale or Title Transfer | any | never cured |
